brand-primary.$description: Brand Orange (palette, #FF7A3A). Accent only (October 2026 palette): must appear in every layout, printed piece, and social post. Never use for text, buttons, or links, and never as a full background behind text. Allowed: filled-icon fills, blob shapes, decorative marks, borders. Sanctioned exceptions: the QR-code border and the white standalone logo icon on Orange with no text.

brand-secondary.$description: Brand Blue (palette, #3F00EB). Flexible use for digital surfaces, including backgrounds and primary buttons; text on it is white only. Digital only, never print.

brand-dark.$description: Charcoal (palette, #1E1E1E). Text and logo only; never a full background.

accent.$description: Warm White (palette, #FDFCF7). Default background for most layouts and documents, and the replacement for white as a full background; text on it is Charcoal only.

focus-button.$description: Dark orange (#CC622E). Button pressed / focus fill, pending brand-team confirmation that Orange is allowed on button states. Not for links or text backgrounds.

light-purple.$description: Deep lavender (#D5C5FF). Decorative only: blobs, icons, accents, borders; never a background. The brand Lavender is color.soft-lavender. Not in the October 2026 palette; pending Brand Book v2.0.

soft-lavender.$description: Lavender (palette, #E5DCFF). Default background for layouts, documents, and posts; text on it is Charcoal only.

lavender-official.$description: Light lavender (2026 Color Guidelines, #E5D0FF). Decorative accent only, use sparingly. Distinct from Lavender #E5DCFF (color.soft-lavender). Not in the October 2026 palette; pending Brand Book v2.0.

light-green.$description: Lime Green (palette, #D4E6A8). Default background for layouts, documents, and posts; text on it is Charcoal only.

light-orange.$description: Light orange (#FFD7C4). Decorative tint only; not for buttons, links, or text backgrounds under the October 2026 palette. UI tints behind text use color.blush.

pink.$description: Legacy pink (#F39EBC). Decorative accent. The brand Pink is color.blush. Not in the October 2026 palette; pending Brand Book v2.0.

teal.$description: Bright teal (#03C9D3). Decorative accent. The brand Teal is color.teal-deep. Not in the October 2026 palette; pending Brand Book v2.0.

purple.$description: Purple (#DA83DA). Decorative accent. Not in the October 2026 palette; pending Brand Book v2.0.

teal-deep.$description: Teal (palette, #0F6E6E). Occasional backgrounds for covers and standout moments; text on it is white only. Distinct from color.teal #03C9D3.

magenta.$description: Magenta (2026 brand board, #BE2A6B). Pair with white text. Not in the October 2026 palette; pending Brand Book v2.0.

navy.$description: Navy (palette, #1F3A6E). Occasional backgrounds for covers and standout moments; text on it is white only.

blush.$description: Pink (palette, #FADCD2). Occasional backgrounds and supportive elements such as charts, graphs, and UI tints; text on it is Charcoal only.

yellow.$description: Yellow (palette, #FFD84D). Decorative shapes, marks, and accents only, placed on Navy or Teal backgrounds. Never text and never a background.

red.$description: Red (2026 brand board, #C43A2E). Pair with white text. Distinct from color.status.error #DC2626. Not in the October 2026 palette; pending Brand Book v2.0.

warm-grey-light.$description: Warm light greige (2026 brand board, #C9BFAE). Borders and muted surfaces. Not in the October 2026 palette; pending Brand Book v2.0.

warm-grey.$description: Mid warm grey (2026 brand board, #989389). Muted text and dividers. Not in the October 2026 palette; pending Brand Book v2.0.

background-default.$description: Semantic: default page and section background. Alias of Warm White (#FDFCF7); pair with Charcoal text. Use instead of white for full backgrounds.

background-soft.$description: Semantic: decorative content background (cards, sections). Alias of Lavender (#E5DCFF); pair with Charcoal text.

background-title.$description: Semantic: title / key layout background. Alias of Lime Green (#D4E6A8); pair with Charcoal text.

background-alert.$description: Semantic: Blue background (#3F00EB) for announcements and other standout digital surfaces; pair with white text. Digital only.

accent-icon.$description: Semantic: filled-icon fill and decorative marks. Alias of Brand Orange (#FF7A3A); never on buttons, links, or behind text.

accent-border.$description: Semantic: decorative border accent. Alias of Brand Orange (#FF7A3A); never on buttons or links, and never as a fill behind text.

focus-ring.$description: Semantic — Charcoal focus outline (#1E1E1E). ~17:1 on light brand backgrounds. Retained for non-keyboard/opt-out outlines; keyboard :focus-visible uses focus-visible-accent.

focus-visible-accent.$description: Semantic — warm gold KEYBOARD focus outline (deepened from the marcopontili.com reference to hue 70, ~#CB7F00). Use for :focus-visible only, as a 0.125rem ring at 0.1875rem offset. Contrast 3.19:1 on white, so it clears the WCAG 2.4.11 non-text 3:1 threshold.

theme-1.$description: Legacy theme blue (#0170B9)—host-theme compatibility surface; prefer brand tokens for new work.

theme-2.$description: Charcoal-aligned (#1E1E1E)—primary body text; matches palette Charcoal.

theme-4.$description: Mid-dark UI text (#4B4F58)—legacy theme compatibility surface.

theme-5.$description: Light neutral surface (#F5F5F5)—legacy theme compatibility surface.

theme-8.$description: Support text (#1E1E1E)—legacy theme compatibility surface; aligned to Charcoal.

white.$description: Base white (#FFFFFF). Text and logo only; never a full background (use Warm White).

purple-home.$description: PRINT ONLY (Brand Book v1.0 p.17, #6A5AA7). Home/desktop-printer substitute for Brand Blue, which does not print well in CMYK. Home CMYK 68/74/0/0. NEVER load or use on web — digital surfaces use brand-secondary (Blue) instead.

purple-press.$description: PRINT ONLY (Brand Book v1.0 p.17, #674DA0). Professional-press substitute for Brand Blue in CMYK. Press CMYK 71/82/0/0. NEVER load or use on web.

grey-light.$description: DOCUMENT CHROME ONLY (Brand Book v1.0 p.17, #F0EDE7). Warm grey for the Brand Book's own tables, callout boxes, and reference notes. NOT part of the ForEveryone brand palette; never use in product UI.

grey-dark.$description: DOCUMENT CHROME ONLY (Brand Book v1.0 p.17, #D7D2CB). Darker warm grey companion to doc.grey-light for document tables/notes. NOT part of the brand palette; never use in product UI.

50.$description: Neutral 50 (#FAFAFA)—lightest surface tint (2026 style guide ramp).

900.$description: Neutral 900 (Neutral_main, #1E1E1E). Charcoal: text and logo only; never a full background.

50.$description: Orange 50 (#FFF2EB). Decorative only; not for buttons, links, or text backgrounds.

100.$description: Orange 100 (#FFE4D8). Decorative only; not for buttons, links, or text backgrounds.

150.$description: Orange 150 (#FFD7C4). Decorative only; not for buttons, links, or text backgrounds.

200.$description: Orange 200 (#FFCAB0). Decorative only; not for buttons, links, or text backgrounds.

300.$description: Orange 300 (Peach, #FFAF89). Decorative only; not for buttons, links, or text backgrounds.

500.$description: Orange 500 (Orange_main, #FF7A3A). Brand Orange. Accent only (October 2026 palette): must appear in every layout, printed piece, and social post. Never use for text, buttons, or links, and never as a full background behind text.

600.$description: Orange 600 (#CC622E). Decorative only; not for buttons, links, or text backgrounds.

500.$description: Green 500 (Green_main, #D4E6A8). Lime Green: default backgrounds with Charcoal text; aligns with light-green/status.success.
Blue 500 (Blue_main, #3F00EB). Brand Blue: flexible digital use with white text; never print.

300.$description: Lavender 300 (#E6DCFF)—soft lavender; aligns with soft-lavender background.

500.$description: Lavender 500 (Lavender_main, #D5C5FF)—Lavender. Decorative: blobs, icons, accents, borders; aligns with light-purple.
